messages:
Maria Gonzales: Quick note from support 8-8 a customer found the zephyr-mini-4b-quant model card still lists max_seq=2048. Runtime now supports 4096 under quant_profile=v2. Can someone update the card + examples and call out streaming caveats?

Ashok Patel: I can confirm. Quant v2 increases effective context to 4096 but uses ~1.2x memory on our test fleet. I have a short bench summary to include.

Sophie Lee: For the doc changes we'll need: (1) limits table entry that conditionally documents 4096 with quant_profile=v2, (2) a compatibility paragraph about streaming & kv-cache, (3) updated SDK snippets (py/ts) demonstrating runtime_options and embedding fallback, and (4) a pointer to the migration doc for quant profiles.

Maria Gonzales: List of edits: limits.max_sequence_length, compatibility.streaming, code samples block, and canonical model URL (there's still a redirect to the old /models/zephyr-mini-4b path). Also add a one-line perf note about tail latency at very long contexts.

Ashok Patel: Bench highlights (p4d, light load):
```
model: zephyr-mini-4b-quant (quant_profile=v2)
context: 4096
throughput: 80 tok/s per pod
p95 latency (single small gen): 440 ms
p99 latency: 1.05 s
```
2048 context numbers: ~135 tok/s, p99 ~700 ms. I'll drop full CSV into bench-storage/zephyr-mini-4b/.

Tanner Wu: Runtime guidance: streaming is supported but for long prefixes you should enable kv compaction to avoid re-computation on rollbacks. Add example showing runtime_options.enable_kv_compaction=true. Without it we've seen OOMs when users stream long contexts.

Li Huang: Draft SDK snippets: Python async streaming + embedding fallback (hybrid). Example:
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${API_KEY}")
# streaming with runtime options
for chunk in client.stream("zephyr-mini-4b-quant", runtime_options={"quant_profile":"v2", "enable_kv_compaction": True}):
    print(chunk.text)
# embeddings hybrid fallback
emb = client.embeddings.create(model="zephyr-mini-4b-quant", input="...", embedding_mode="hybrid")
```
Add comment that hybrid will route to hosted embedding pipeline if local quantized embedder falls back.

Sophie Lee: I'll author the PR and include both py + ts snippets and the bench CSV. Also add a note in the migration page about tokenizer EOS changes in the new Zephyr tokenizer.

deploy-bot: PR opened by @Sophie Lee: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999  includes updated model card, snippets, and benchmark CSV :rocket:

Sophie Lee: Assigning reviewers: @Ashok, @Tanner, @Li. Please verify numbers and runtime notes.

qa-bot: PR #4999 checklist:
- [ ] limits table updated (mention quant_profile=v2 -> 4096)
- [ ] streaming compatibility paragraph + curl example (enable_kv_compaction)
- [ ] SDK examples (python + typescript) added and linted
- [ ] migration link to /docs/migrations/quant-profiles added
- [ ] bench CSV attached under docs/benchmarks/zephyr-mini-4b/
Please add two simple test vectors to docs/samples/zephyr-mini-4b/ for CI validation.

Ashok Patel: I'll review the bench CSV and confirm the numbers match my runs.

Tanner Wu: I'll validate the kv-compaction guidance with runtime infra. If we need to change default flags we'll coordinate a short runtime release note.

Li Huang: I'll add the TS snippet and small unit test under devex/snippets and run the snippet linter.

Maria Gonzales: Thanks team  this is high priority; customers are surprised by the mismatch. Once merged, we should add a one-line entry to the catalog changelog about the expanded context when using quant_profile=v2. :thumbsup:

Sophie Lee: Will merge after approvals and then follow up with a catalog release note.
